items.title: GPT-OSS vs. Qwen3 and a detailed look how things evolved since GPT-2
items.raw_content: OpenAI just released their new open-weight LLMs this week: gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b, their first open-weight models since GPT-2 in 2019. And yes, thanks to some clever optimizations, they can run locally (but more about this later). This is the first time since GPT-2 that OpenAI has shared a large, fully open-weight model. Earlier GPT models showed how the transformer architecture scales. The 2022 ChatGPT release then made these models mainstream by demonstrating concrete usefulness for writing and knowledge (and later coding) tasks. Now they have shared some long-awaited weight model, and the architecture has some interesting details.
items.title_zh: GPT-OSS 对比 Qwen3：细看自 GPT-2 以来的架构演变
items.summary: OpenAI released gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b, its first open-weight models since GPT-2 in 2019, and the post compares them with Qwen3 while tracing architectural changes since GPT-2.

items.title: How attention sinks keep language models stable

items.title: Policy to Assist Iteratively Local Segmentation: Optimising Modality and Location Selection for Prostate Cancer Localisation
items.title_zh: 辅助迭代式局部分割的策略：优化前列腺癌定位的成像模态与位置选择
items.summary: The paper proposes a policy network that recommends the best imaging modality and image regions for review, iterating with a pre-trained segmentation model to localize prostate cancer; on 1,325 labelled multiparametric MRI images, the approach surpassed standard segmentation networks.

items.title: Too Categorical to be Human: Emotion Concepts in LLMs and Humans
items.title_zh: 过于分类化而不像人类：LLM 与人类的情感概念
items.summary: Using a benchmark of emotional scenarios across 15 emotion categories, the study finds that LLMs represent emotion concepts more categorically, homogeneously and determinately than humans.

items.title: From Nodes to Narratives: Explaining Graph Neural Networks with LLMs and Graph Context
items.title_zh: 从节点到叙事：用大语言模型与图上下文解释图神经网络
items.summary: GSPELL is a lightweight post-hoc framework that projects GNN node embeddings into an LLM embedding space and builds hybrid prompts so the model can produce natural-language explanations plus concise explanation subgraphs; on real-world text-attributed graph datasets it shows a favorable fidelity-sparsity trade-off and better human-centric metrics.

items.title: VisR-Bench: An Empirical Study on Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Multilingual Long Document Understanding
items.title_zh: VisR-Bench：多语言长文档视觉检索增强生成的实证研究
items.summary: VisR-Bench is a multilingual benchmark of more than 35K QA pairs over 1.2K documents in 16 languages for visual retrieval-augmented generation, where MLLMs still struggle with tables and low-resource languages.
